allocation_comparisons.interpretation: The random-head rounded candidate must meet every absolute criterion and paired requirement against random-head matched-free. The privileged-head rounded anchor is descriptive and cannot rescue failure. The same exact updates and paired minibatches do not equalize gradients or compute. Generic random logits change the initialization scale as well as removing the cost-template prior.

limitations: Original process, source and payload admission belongs to the external caller.
Exact targets and reference posterior use known dynamics; learned models receive only public histories and supervised labels.
Every completed allocation has the same exact prefix and joint update counts, not equal FLOPs or actual wall time. The common wall cap is a failure boundary, not a stopping target.
All arms use full-batch prefix updates then the same cursor-derived joint batches. Matched initial probabilities do not imply matched gradients.

A successful allocation admits only the exact requested updates with no discarded work. Any late or failed update prevents DEV admission; the original failed record remains evidence. All fit setup, checkpoints and final-summary work count within the cap.
All model and optimizer boundary states are independently decoded and hashed; intermediate hashes, update losses, historical timing and source-qualified execution are not replayed.

All saved transitions are independently reconstructed from raw boundary parameters. Both rounded arms receive four-sweep/slack boundary correction diagnostics; the matched-free control uses its actual column softmax.
Boundary correction magnitudes and residuals do not bound unobserved intermediate training states; optimizer steps and runtime normalization guards are not replayed.
Equal stored parameter counts, initial functions and update counts do not establish equal degrees of freedom, gradients or compute.
Batch schedules, public-label target arithmetic and structural forward counts are reconstructed without any model or optimizer call.

The five joint_reuse routes own actual shared operations once; legacy training_blind/observed are unused and training_prefix contains only prefix-stage work. Logical rollout counters remain distinct from physical operations and backward FLOPs.
Observed filtering receives intervening observations and remains separate from blind extrapolation.
The random-head candidate must pass all three absolute criteria and every comparison against random-head matched-free. The privileged-head anchor cannot rescue a failed condition.
The declared random initializer is reconstructed once per fit seed, separately counted from model/world calls; all actual checkpoint head bytes and paired dynamics-only prefix boundaries are checked.

Removing the cost-template initialization also changes its scale and shape. Supervised cost labels and the favorable doubly stochastic world remain; this does not isolate arbitrary latent identification or prove transfer.
This synthetic exact-update rounded-transition diagnostic establishes neither latent identification, native transfer, statistical significance nor architectural novelty.

structural_work_scope: Actual forward work by arm: training_prefix is the prefix-only stage; five joint_reuse_* routes own disjoint shared fields, endpoint filtering, all-attempt NLL and two continuations. Legacy training_blind/training_observed routes are empty. Evaluation routes are unchanged. Logical rollout counters are not physical shared operations or backward FLOPs. Excludes separately recorded construction/diagnostic work, validation FLOPs, backward operations, optimizer work and memory allocation.
